sentences.text:
Shri Vikram Singh -Advocate for the respondent through 
conferencing.
Record of the trial court has been received.
Admit.

Also heard on I.A. No.13023/2025, which is an application filed under Section 430(1) of BNSS, 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant no.1/Kapil Parte and appellant no.2/Dilip Singh Chauhan.

The appellants have been tried and convicted by order dated 16.05.2025 passed by 18th Additional Session Court, Bhopal in S.T No. 555/2019 for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 471 of IPC and sentenced to suffer R.I for 3 years and with fine and further under section 3(dha) (2) read with section 4 of the M.P Recognized Examination Act, and under section 120(B) of IPC and sentenced to suffer R.I for 3 years and with fine and sentenced to R.I for 3 years and with fine respectively with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the appellants submit that vide order dated 02.06.2025 passed by this Court,
the suspension of sentence as granted by the trial court was extended till the next date of hearing.
As per period of incarceration during the trial, the appellants have already undergone 2 CRA-5260-2025 substantial period of sentence, which is almost 1/4 of their jail sentence.
The maximum sentence imposed is only of three years.
This appeal is not going to be heard finally in near future.
During the trial, the appellants have never misused the liberty of bail.
Therefore, the prayer is made to suspend the jail sentence of the appellants.
Learned counsel for the respondent has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
